title: Aws Security Advisories - 2026-11-02
description:
Merged 4 aws security advisories published on 2026-11-02. Original advisory IDs: 2026-162-aws, 2026-163-aws, 2026-164-aws, 2026-161-aws

Titles:
- CVE-2026-119085 - Template injection in the publishing component of Virtual Engineering Workbench
- CVE-2026-120497 - Stored cross-site scripting in the HTML report generator of aidlc-traceability in AWS AI-DLC Workflows
- CVE-2026-116635 - Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory in the deployment status component of the AWS Serverless MCP Server
- CVE-2026-119301 - Improper neutralization of quoting syntax in Apache Iceberg SQL identifier generation in AWS SDK for pandas
